name: Muhlnickel 32-bit CPU Demo
description: Visualization of a 32-bit stored-program processor baked as a gate netlist inside titan.gguf. The CPU fetches, decodes, executes, and writes back — all in gates. 15-operation ISA, verified byte-exact against a reference emulator.

pfc_cpu32.isa: HALT LDA STA ADD SUB AND OR XOR SHL SHR LT EQ JMP JZ LDI

isa.13: JZ addr — if ACC == 0 then PC = addr

programs.bitwise: AND, OR, XOR, SHL, SHR operations

binary.note: Read-only at runtime. The CPU netlist is stored in the model's parameter tensors. No fixed size constraint.

host_role: TWO things only: inject electron (set inputs = current state), surface output (read next state). Nothing else.
